question.text: The order of the differential equation of the family of circles touching the <math><mi>y</mi></math>-axis at the origin is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math>, then the maximum value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo> </mo><mo>∀</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>R</mi></math> is

solution.text:
The equation of the family is x-a2+y2=a2, which has only one arbitrary constant
∴ the order will be 1.
Hence, the maximum value of y=kcos⁡x=cos⁡x is ‘1’
